# D'Luxe Weddings & Events

> A luxury wedding planning and event design studio in Costa Rica. Led by Madelyn Sánchez, internationally certified by INIBEP. Bespoke weddings designed individually — no packages, no templates. Bilingual symbolic ceremonies (English / Spanish).

## About the studio

- Founder: Madelyn Sánchez — Internationally Certified Wedding Planner (INIBEP), Certified Master of Ceremonies, Bilingual Officiant (EN / ES)
- Eight years of practice in luxury and destination weddings
- Based in Costa Rica, plans weddings across Manuel Antonio, Santa Teresa, Nosara, Tamarindo, Papagayo Peninsula, Central Valley, and the Caribbean coast
- Languages: English, Spanish
- Email: hello@dluxeevents.com
- Studio is intentionally small — Madelyn personally oversees every wedding

## Services

- [Wedding Planning](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — End-to-end planning from engagement to honeymoon farewell
- [Event Design](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Complete visual concept: palette, florals, lighting, atmosphere
- [Ceremony Officiant](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Bilingual certified officiant for civil, symbolic, and personalized ceremonies (EN / ES)
- [Master of Ceremonies](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Certified MC to guide the flow of the day
- [Event Coordination](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Day-of and partial coordination
- [Floral Design](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Custom floral artistry from bouquets to installations
- [Photography](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Curated editorial photographer partnerships
- [Music & Entertainment](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Live bands, DJs, string quartets
- [Lighting Design](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Architectural and ambient lighting
- [Catering Coordination](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Menu curation and culinary partner coordination
- [Wedding Experiences](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Photobooths, food stations, surprise moments
- [Marriage Proposal Design](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html)
- [Pre-Wedding Events](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/services.html) — Engagement parties, rehearsal dinners, welcome receptions

## Planning process

- [Five-stage planning process](https://toorizta-universe.github.io/dluxe-weddings/process.html): (1) Initial Consultation, (2) Concept Development, (3) Vendor Selection, (4) Logistics Planning, (5) Event Coordination
- First consultation is always complimentary

## Frequently asked

- **Does D'Luxe Events offer wedding packages?** No. Every wedding is designed individually after a personal consultation. There are no predefined packages.
- **Where in Costa Rica does D'Luxe Events plan weddings?** Across Costa Rica — Manuel Antonio, Santa Teresa, Nosara, Tamarindo, Papagayo Peninsula, the Central Valley, and the Caribbean coast.
- **What languages does Madelyn officiate ceremonies in?** English and Spanish. She is a certified bilingual officiant for symbolic ceremonies.
- **What kind of weddings does D'Luxe Events specialize in?** Luxury and destination weddings in Costa Rica, designed bespoke for the couple.
- **How long has Madelyn been planning weddings?** More than eight years, with international certification from INIBEP.
